reddit.title: Introducing Materials Instead of Cost Badges in Provincia
reddit.body: We're excited to share a significant update in Provincia! Build tiles now display a detailed materials sheet instead of a single cost chip, making it easier to manage resources. Each tile shows the materials required versus what you have, with shortages clearly highlighted. This change enhances your building experience, allowing you to plan better while constructing your colony. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges

steam.title: Provincia Update: Materials Instead of Cost Badges
steam.body: We're thrilled to announce a major update for Provincia! Build tiles now feature a materials sheet that displays all required and stored resources, replacing the previous single cost chip system. This enhancement allows for clearer resource management and better planning as you build your colony. Check out all the details on our devtalk page: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/materials-instead-of-cost-badges?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=materials-instead-of-cost-badges
